H2984.name: Ibhar
H2984.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H2984.brief: One of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.
H2984.short: Ibhar was one of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, as recorded in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

H2997.name: Ibneiah
H2997.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2997.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
H2997.short: Ibneiah, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the Israelites who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2998.name: Ibnijah
H2998.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2998.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
H2998.short: Ibnijah, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the Israelites who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2970I.name: Jaazaniah
H2970I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2970I.brief: Leader among the twenty-five men in Ezekiel's vision.
H2970I.short: Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, was one of the twenty-five men in Ezekiel's vision who were devising iniquity and giving wicked counsel.

H2970H.name: Jaazaniah
H2970H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2970H.brief: Israelite elder; participated in idolatry in the temple.
H2970H.short: Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan, was one of the seventy elders of Israel who participated in idolatrous practices in the temple, as seen in Ezekiel's vision.

H2970G.name: Jaazaniah
H2970G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2970G.brief: Son of Jeremiah; a Rechabite during Jeremiah's time.
H2970G.short: Jaazaniah, the son of Jeremiah, was a Rechabite who was tested by the prophet Jeremiah for his obedience to his ancestor's commands.

H2989.name: Jabal
H2989.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H2989.brief: Son of Lamech; father of nomadic herdsmen.
H2989.short: Jabal, the son of Lamech and Adah, was the ancestor of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

H2985H.name: Jabin
H2985H.brief: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.
H2985H.short: Jabin, a Canaanite king of Hazor, oppressed Israel for twenty years until he was defeated by Deborah and Barak.

H2985G.name: Jabin
H2985G.brief: King of Hazor; led Canaanite coalition against Joshua.
H2985G.short: Jabin, king of Hazor, formed an alliance with other Canaanite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites.

H2971J.name: Jair
H2971J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2971J.short: Jair was the father of Mordecai, a Benjamite mentioned in the book of Esther.

H2971I.name: Jair
H2971I.short: Jair the Gileadite was a judge who led Israel for twenty-two years.

H2971G.name: Jair
H2971G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2971G.short: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured the region of Gilead.

H2979.name: Jeatherai
H2979.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2979.brief: Levite, son of Zerah, ancestor of Asaph
H2979.short: Jeatherai, also known as Ethni, was a Levite, the son of Zerah, and an ancestor of Asaph.

H2983G.name: Jebusites
H2983G.brief: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest
H2983G.short: The Jebusites were a Canaanite tribe that inhabited Jerusalem before King David conquered the city.

H2977G.name: Josiah
H2977G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2977G.brief: King of Judah known for his religious reforms
H2977G.short: Josiah was a king of Judah who instituted significant religious reforms and repaired the temple.

H2977H.name: Josiah
H2977H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2977H.brief: One who provided silver and gold for a crown
H2977H.short: Josiah (or Hen), along with others, provided silver and gold for a crown in a symbolic act during Zechariah's time.

H2929.name: Talmon
H2929.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2929.brief: Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylonian exile
H2929.short: Talmon was a Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylon and served at the temple.

H2955.name: Taphath
H2955.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H2955.brief: Daughter of Solomon; wife of Ben-abinadab
H2955.short: Taphath was a daughter of Solomon who married Ben-abinadab, one of Solomon's district governors.

H2928H.name: Telem
H2928H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2928H.brief: Temple servant who married a foreign wife
H2928H.short: Telem was a temple servant who married a foreign wife during the Exile and later divorced her.

H2900H.name: Tobiah
H2900H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2900H.brief: Ancestor of returned exiles unable to prove lineage
H2900H.short: Tobiah was an ancestor of some returned exiles who were unable to prove their Israelite lineage and were excluded from the priesthood.

H2900I.name: Tobiah
H2900I.desc: Nehemiah's adversary living at the time of Exile and Return
H2900I.brief: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts
H2900I.short: Tobiah was an Ammonite official who, along with Sanballat the Horonite, opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

H2900G.name: Tobijah
H2900G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2900G.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
H2900G.short: Tobijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

H2900J.name: Tobijah
H2900J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2900J.brief: Postexilic Jew who provided silver and gold for crowns
H2900J.short: Tobijah was a postexilic Jew who, along with others, provided silver and gold to make crowns for Joshua the high priest.

H2991.name: Ibleam
H2991.short: Ibleam (Bileam, Gath-rimmon), a Levitical city in Issachar.

H2999.name: Jabbok
H2999.brief: A river east of the Jordan, associated with Jacob
H2999.short: The Jabbok, a river east of the Jordan, where Jacob wrestled with God.

H2995G.name: Jabneel
H2995G.brief: A town on the border of Judah, later fortified
H2995G.short: Jabneel (Jabneh), a town on the border of Judah, later fortified by Uzziah.

H2995H.name: Jabneel
H2995H.brief: A town on the border of Naphtali
H2995H.short: Jabneel, a town on the border of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 19:33">Joshua 19:33</ref>).

H2971H.name: Jair
H2971H.brief: An Israelite who possessed towns in Gilead
H2971H.short: Jair, an Israelite who possessed towns in Gilead (<ref="Joshua 13:30">Joshua 13:30</ref>).

H2975G.name: Nile
H2975G.brief: The major river of Egypt, mentioned in various contexts
H2975G.short: The Nile, the major river of Egypt, is mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible, often in relation to the history of Israel and God's judgment on Egypt.

H2923.name: Telaim
H2923.brief: Place where Saul gathered his army
H2923.short: Telaim, a place where Saul gathered his army before attacking the Amalekites (<ref="1Sam. 15:4">1Sam. 15:4</ref>).

H2928G.name: Telem
H2928G.brief: Town in the Negev region of Judah
H2928G.short: Telem, a town in the Negev region of Judah, allotted to the tribe of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:24">Josh. 15:24</ref>).

H2967.name: Tarpelite
H2967.brief: A group of officials in the Persian Empire
H2967.short: The Tarpelites were a group of officials in the Persian Empire who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezra 4:9">Ezra 4:9</ref>).
